headline: A quiet day with no new events
body: No new events were scored. All endings moved by less than 0.1 point as earlier news faded; Gatekeeper slipped about 0.05 as the boost from recent rule-making wore off. The world factors held steady after a busy week, and Horizon Balance was almost unchanged at -0.45.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.06 and Protector God -0.05.
